_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county_probate_court.label: County Probate Court
county_probate_court.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

docket_number.label: Docket Number
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

estate_of_decedent.label: Estate Of Decedent
estate_of_decedent.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

residence_of_decedent.label: Residence Of Decedent
residence_of_decedent.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

date_of_death_or_appointment.label: Date Of Death Or Appointment
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

person_making_demand_contact.label: Person Making Demand Contact
person_making_demand_contact.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

interest_in_estate.label: Interest In Estate
interest_in_estate.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

other_interest_description.label: Other Interest Description
other_interest_description.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

copy_of_docket_sheet.label: Copy Of Docket Sheet
copy_of_docket_sheet.expects: check only if the statement is true

copy_of_findings_and_orders.label: Copy Of Findings And Orders
copy_of_findings_and_orders.expects: check only if the statement is true

attorney_info.label: Attorney Info
attorney_info.expects: free text answering the printed prompt
